reviews.text:
After reading all the reviews, I feel better that Im not the only one who feels like they’ve been taken advantage of.
I ordered 2 dresses, they both were very large, the sizing chart is not consistent, fabric cheap looking and feeling. Tried to return with their “ easy return policy”, LOL, after they offered me first $20.00, then $36.00, for $107.00 purchase, I decided I’d return the items knowing I had to pay for the return. I go to the UPS store, and it was going to cost over $200.00 to send the merchandise to DUBAI!! This company stinks, don’t buy from them. If I could give them a minus, it would be -5 stars. I now am waiting for my C C company to handle this, wish me luck
reviews.author: Cathy Tiano

reviews.text: I placed an order for 3 items. I carefully reviewed the return policy and felt assured they would honor that. However, the policy says you must contact customer service to process a return. I wanted to return 1 item. After 4 attempts to reach them, they still would not respond. Which is interesting since right after I placed the initial order, I reached out to them for a change in the delivery address. They responded instantly! They just hoped I would give up on the return request. Eventually I did. Be very careful about ordering from this company. Be sure you have  money to burn because they will not help you return!
reviews.author: SUSAN COOPER

reviews.text:
The items were too big and I asked for a full refund, first they offered to exchange but I wanted a refund, then they offered a discount, I asked for a refund, then they offered a bigger discount, I asked for a refund or a bigger discount. They stopped communicating altogether, I emailed four more times asking for them to communicate but they never responded. 
I am left with over a hundred dollars worth of clothes that won’t fit and they won’t respond. 
My advice would be to NEVER DO BUSINESS with them, to spend your money at reputable stores and be happy.  I am totally disgusted.

reviews.text:

reviews.text:
I have never felt so neglected by a company before. If I could give less than one star I would. 

I want to preface this by saying that I rarely complain about customer service issues because I have worked in customer service myself. I completely understand that things get busy and that delays happen, so I was incredibly patient with them. However, my experience with Kotn’s customer service was beyond frustrating.

I placed an order in November, but due to the Canada Post strike, I didn’t receive my packages until well into January. One of the packages was lost in transit, and I needed to return some of the items. That’s when the real nightmare began.

I reached out to customer service, and I was assigned a representative named Nouran. Unfortunately, communication was painfully slow—she often took days, sometimes even a full week, to reply. Because of this, I felt like I had to respond immediately to every email just to avoid another long delay. Even worse, despite my repeated messages, I found myself constantly re-explaining the same request over and over again.

One of my biggest frustrations was trying to get a Canada Post return label instead of a FedEx one. I made this request multiple times, yet my emails were either completely ignored or met with vague responses asking me to “reconfirm” what I had already stated clearly. It felt like I was stuck in an endless loop of waiting and repeating myself, with no actual resolution in sight.

It is now almost March, and I am still dealing with this issue—something that should have been resolved months ago. The lack of efficiency, responsiveness, and basic customer service skills has made this an incredibly frustrating experience. I will not be shopping here again.
reviews.author: Shelagh Joseph

reviews.text:
Made an online purchase shortly before Christmas which arrived very quickly (despite a postage strike where I live). I ended up making an in-store return and the refund came through really quickly. 

Only piece of feedback is that when I did the return in store they gave me no receipt or physical validation of any kind as proof that I’d made the return. Just said that I’d receive an email confirmation of the return within 1-2 business days. When the confirmation showed up, the amount on it showed up as $0.00, which made me worry something had gone wrong with the order. It occurred to me in retrospect that if something had gone wrong with their tech/systems and my refund confirmation email hadn’t come through that I’d have no way of proving that I’d actually made that return (which was a bit worrying - I felt silly, like I should have insisted on some sort of physical proof of the return when I was in store).

As it happened, I emailed them with my concerns regarding the $0.00 amount and was reassured that that’s just how their systems worked and that the refund had gone through fine (which was true, I received the refund within just a few days of returning and it had been safely in my bank account for about a week before they replied to my email). 

All in all a great experience with Kotn even though the clothes were not for me!
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.text:
I like the quality of a lot of their items but their sizing is so off. Why is no one doing anything to fix this? Their socks while very plush and comfortable run HUGE while being too tight on the ankle. I'm a woman's US size 9 and while I usually order M/L I had to give those to my husband (and they may even be too big for him!). I re-ordered size S/M and they're still almost too big! On top of that for some reason the grey socks are noticeably much larger than the other colors in the same size. There is no excuse for this kind of inconsistency.
I recently ordered a long sleeve turtleneck and ordered a size larger based on reviews of it running small. It didn't only run very small, the fit was also all wrong. The waist was somewhere between normal and very cropped length. Way too short. The sleeves too were too short making it look awkward. All this while there was plenty of excess fabric elsewhere on the top. It's not only their sizing that's off but their design/proportions. I am now really hesitant to order any more clothes from them.
reviews.author: Holly

reviews.text:
Placed an Order on March 9, still haven't received it by March 19 in Australia, website says 5-7 days typically which would align if they used Fedex or USPS. 

They used some barely known shipping company called Asendia, the item only left the US on 14th and when I called Asendia they said it could take up to 15 days to reach Australia. I think they have sent via sea and charged a steep shipping fee for a pair of jeans. 

What makes things worse is the customer support is very flippant and reluctant to help, the way they respond with a lack of urgency makes me think they are used to these shipping times and give incorrect information on shipping page. 

They gave a small of $25 from the shipping fee which wasn't the total amount but at least it was something, the issue was they reshipped using the same courier and its taken even longer. 

Arguably one of the most comically bad shopping experiences I have ever had.
reviews.author: Jack

reviews.text:
The worst customer experience I’ve ever experienced in my life (and I’m not exaggerating). I’ve been trying to exchange  a purchase made in December (it is now the end of March). I have received essentially no support from the rep Nouran and my emails go weeks without a response.  I spent hundredsssss of dollars at Kotn outfitting our bedroom and I’m so disappointed in the lack of support or response from them. I’m not even trying to return something. I really wanted to believe that this was due to high volume over Christmas but now that it’s March, this no longer holds. The inability to leave a review on with them directly also says a lot. 

Unfortunately I won’t be purchasing from KOTN again for this exact reason and will share my experience with others. Think twice before you buy because good luck getting any support after your purchase.

My one criticism is when I ordered to the UK and it took quite a long time to arrive. Unfortunately the postal service messed up and didn't notify me my package had arrived and I had a customs charge to pay so my order got sent back to the US, but customer service were lovely and I received a full refund.

I got their t-shirt and Oxford shirt for Christmas and they're so comfortable.

I love their environmental credentials, and wish that more companies invested in sustainable cotton. I'm not a fashionista and usually buy basic stuff at Uniqlo, but Kotn is still affordable and so much better for the planet. Plus, the stuff looks like it'll last longer...

The fashion industry is a massive polluter, and although governments need to regulate more, we still have choices as consumers. We can vote at polling stations, but also with our wallets.

_finding: Measured 2026-09-19 on 157 five-star Trustpilot reviews from 3 scam and 2 legit stores: GPTZero flagged 0 of them, mean prob 0.026-0.040, with no separation between classes. The farmed reviews are cheap HUMAN reviews, not LLM output. Review LENGTH separated the classes well on the same data (review-level AUC 0.796; share of 5-star reviews over 250 chars was 5-7% for scam versus 57% for legit).
